items.title: After Supreme Court ruling, White House does damage control on trade deals

items.desc: The administration is taking a carrot and stick approach with foreign countries after the court struck down a broad swath of the president's tariffs.

items.desc: U.S. tariffs have rerouted trade, but not dented it as much as feared, allowing larger-than-expected economic growth in certain developing markets.
items.desc_zh: 美國關稅改變了貿易路線，但影響不如預期嚴重，某些發展中市場的經濟增長超出預期。

items.title: Don't bet on lower prices, businesses say, even after emergency Trump tariffs were shot down
items.title_zh: 企業稱即使緊急關稅被否決，也別指望價格下降
items.desc: 'We absorbed almost all of the cost of the tariffs; we don't think there's a reason to pay anybody back,' a small business owner tells Reuters.
items.desc_zh: 一位小企業主告訴路透社：'我們幾乎吸收了所有關稅成本；我們認為沒有理由向任何人退還。'
